name: Incomplete Contextual & Visual Memory
definition: Users recall specific visual cues (e.g. clothing color, background objects, weather) or approximate times/locations, but lack searchable filenames or album tags.
failure_mechanism: Keyword search fails to correlate multi-object relationships and contextual scene semantics.
product_implications: Opportunity for multi-modal contextual query expansion and visual attribute binding.
representative_excerpts: typing 'yellow raincoat dog' brought up hundreds of random outdoor shots and missed the exact one
Searched 'white boat blue sails' because I took a photo during our vacation in Greece
open_questions: How frequently do users abandon multi-word episodic queries?
Can conversational follow-up questions clarify vague visual memories?

name: OCR & Document Scene Misclassification
definition: Users photograph physical receipts, tickets, whiteboards, or signs with partial or blurry text, where OCR and scene tagging fail to index the document payload.
failure_mechanism: OCR misses slanted or low-contrast text; scene classifiers categorize the surrounding furniture instead of the document.
product_implications: Requires enhanced document rectification and hybrid visual-text embedding extraction.
representative_excerpts: Impossible to find old car lease documents because optical character recognition completely missed the blurry vehicle identification number
open_questions: What percentage of retrieval queries target captured text documents?
